chunks: 15 – Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Zakariyya, al-Bazūfarī, al-ʿAdawī, from ʿAdī al-Rabāb.

Very weak. He narrated a manuscript from Muḥammad ibn Ṣadaqa, from Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (peace be upon him), and he narrated from Khirāsh, from Anas. His affair is famous enough to not need to be mentioned.

key_terms.أَشْهَرُ مِنْ أَنْ يُذْكَرَ: Famous enough to not need to be mentioned (idiom for well-known status)
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا: Very weak (a technical term in hadith sciences indicating low reliability)

ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya al-Bazufari and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book 'Kitab al- Duafa' (The Book of the Weak) regarding the narrator Al--Hasan ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya, known as al-Bazufari. It describes him as 'very weak' in terms of reliability, notes his transmission from Musa ibn Jafar (AS) and others, and concludes that his status as a weak narrator is so well-known that it does not require further elaboration.

en.tashayyu: 15 – al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Zakariyya, al-Bazūfarī, al-ʿAdawī from ʿAdī al-Rabāb.
